notes: Four branches joined by «ح»; «كلهم عن الأعمش» closes them, so the names written once after it form the shared tail (rule 3).
«أبو كريب، محمد بن العلاء» is one man: kunya, comma, name (rule 7).
«إسحاق، بن إبراهيم» of the second branch keeps its stray comma and is not merged with the first branch's «إسحاق بن إبراهيم» (rule 9).
The gloss «- يعني ابن غياث -» is left out; «قال قال رسول الله» ends at the Companion Jarir b. Abdullah, the Prophet being no link.
